audit_items.proof_trace: The route handler performs no authentication or admin role check — it only validates the time window (22:50–23:50 JST). The middleware (src/middleware.ts:33-46) checks only for the PRESENCE of `oauth_user_id` and `oauth_access_token` cookies (truthy check), not their validity; an attacker can set arbitrary non-empty values for these cookies to bypass the middleware gate entirely. Neither the route nor `forceLogoutAll()` in actions.ts verifies caller identity or admin status.
audit_items.attack_scenario: An unauthenticated attacker sends `GET /api/admin/force-logout-all` with headers `Cookie: oauth_user_id=x; oauth_access_token=y` (any non-empty strings) between 22:50–23:50 JST; the middleware passes the request through, and `forceLogoutAll()` executes — force-logging out all currently checked-in users.
